commit.message:
fix(llmchat): harden outbound MCP connections in the LLM Chat client (#7658)

* fix(llmchat): pin outbound MCP connections to validated addresses

The LLM Chat MCP client validated the server URL once and then connected by hostname. The HTTP client resolved the name again at connection time.

Validate the URL on each connection with resolve_pinned_target(). Give the streamable HTTP and SSE transports a client factory that dials only the validated addresses and does not follow redirects.

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

* fix(transport): do not follow redirects in the default streamable HTTP client

The default client in streamable_http_client() followed redirects. A redirect can send a request to a destination that outbound URL validation never checked. Set follow_redirects=False, as the other outbound MCP clients do.

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

* fix(llmchat): share the pinned client factory and report blocked URLs

Move the pinned httpx client factory from upstream_session_registry to
ssrf_pinning.build_pinned_httpx_client_factory(). LLM Chat now uses the
same factory, so a missing timeout falls back to get_httpx2_timeout().

_build_transport() raises ConnectionError with a sanitized URL when the
outbound URL policy blocks the URL. /llmchat/connect maps it to 503.
During a chat, the tool wrapper returns the error to the model as a
ToolException, so the agent run continues.

Add un-mocked deny-path tests for loopback, RFC1918 and link-local
metadata addresses on both HTTP transports. Narrow the dial test to
httpx2.ConnectError.

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

* docs(llmchat): document outbound pinning and blocked redirects

Add a Security entry to the CHANGELOG. Tell operators to configure a
redirecting MCP server with its final URL in LLM Chat.

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

* docs(changelog): drop LLM Chat pinning entry

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>
Co-authored-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

+6. LLM Chat MCP Server Connections
+What Breaks
+
+Scenario: The MCP server URL entered in LLM Chat (`POST /llmchat/connect`) returns a redirect, for example `/mcp` → `/mcp/`.
+
+New Behavior: LLM Chat does not follow the redirect, so tool listing and tool calls fail.
+Mitigation
+
+Enter the final MCP server URL in the LLM Chat connection settings.
+
 Testing Your Integration After Upgrade
 1. Test Tool Invocations

@@ -200,6 +200,8 @@ The LLM Chat functionality is powered by the following REST API endpoints:
 
 `/llmchat/connect` validates user-supplied server URLs with SSRF protections. Under strict defaults, localhost/private addresses are rejected unless explicitly allowed (for example via `SSRF_ALLOWED_NETWORKS` or local development overrides).
 
+LLM Chat validates the URL again before each tool listing and tool call. With SSRF protection enabled and no egress proxy, it connects only to the addresses that passed validation. It does not follow HTTP redirects. If your MCP server redirects (for example `/mcp` to `/mcp/`), enter the final URL. A URL that resolves to a blocked address returns `503` on connect; during a chat, the tool call returns an error message to the model.

+def build_pinned_httpx_client_factory(pinned_target: PinnedTarget) -> HttpxClientFactory:
+    """Build an httpx client factory for one validated target.
+
+    The client dials only the validated addresses when ``pinned_target`` is pinned. An unpinned
+    target (SSRF protection disabled, or an egress proxy applies) gets a plain client that resolves
+    DNS itself. The client never follows redirects.
+
+    Args:
+        pinned_target: The target returned by :func:`resolve_pinned_target`.
+
+    Returns:
+        HttpxClientFactory: A factory accepting ``headers``, ``timeout`` and ``auth``. A missing
+        timeout falls back to ``get_httpx2_timeout()``; TLS uses ``get_default_verify()``.
+    """
+
+    def _pinned_factory(
+        headers: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None,
+        timeout: Optional[httpx2.Timeout] = None,
+        auth: Optional[httpx2.Auth] = None,
+    ) -> httpx2.AsyncClient:
+        """Build the pinned httpx client.
+
+        Args:
+            headers: Optional headers for the client.
+            timeout: Optional timeout for the client.
+            auth: Optional auth for the client.
+
+        Returns:
+            httpx2.AsyncClient: Configured HTTPX async client.
+        """
+        return httpx2.AsyncClient(
+            follow_redirects=False,
+            headers=headers,
+            timeout=timeout if timeout else get_httpx2_timeout(),
+            auth=auth,
+            **pinned_target.client_kwargs(
+                verify=get_default_verify(),
+                limits=httpx2.Limits(
+                    max_connections=settings.httpx_max_connections,
+                    max_keepalive_connections=settings.httpx_max_keepalive_connections,
+                    keepalive_expiry=settings.httpx_keepalive_expiry,
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+
+    return _pinned_factory
